prompts.prompt:
Intended use: the flagship background plate for a small-business marketing campaign. Display type is set over it afterwards, so this is the surface, not the finished piece. Real and restrained, not advertising-slick.

Scene: The service counter of a small independent workshop on an overcast weekday morning, photographed from the customer's side. Pale oiled oak, a window out of frame to the left throwing soft diffuse daylight across the surface.

Subject: Two completely blank, unprinted business cards lying face up and side by side on the counter. One is heavy cotton stock with a crisp square edge and a soft shadow beneath it. The other is thin, slightly curled, with one bruised corner. Nothing is printed on either.

Key details: Visible wood grain and old ring marks under the cards, a fingerprint on the thin card, fine dust in the window light, a worn pen resting near the edge.

Camera and light: 50mm, eye level with the counter surface, shallow depth of field so the cards are sharp and the room behind falls away. One dominant soft daylight source. Natural film grain. Ordinary and unstaged, as if caught in the moment on a working day.

Colour world (mandatory): A LIGHT frame overall - near-white walls around #FAFDF9, mean brightness roughly 160 of 255. Shadows fall to a muted mauve-grey around #33272E. Never a dark or near-black ground. Exactly ONE small olive-green accent object, #7FB449, occupying roughly one to two percent of the frame - a small clip, a spine, a trim detail. The accent reads olive under this light, not chartreuse. No second saturated colour and no green wash anywhere.

Reserved negative space (mandatory): the right third of the frame stays near-empty - one continuous low-detail surface carrying no subject, prop or high-contrast texture. That empty band is where display type lands afterwards.

Text rule (absolute): render zero text. No letters, numerals, words, handwriting, printed copy, signage, screen copy, labels, watermarks, signatures, logos or brand marks anywhere in the frame, including on the cards, paper, screens or clothing. Where a surface would normally carry writing, show it blank. A plate that arrives with generated lettering is unusable.

Exclude: a second saturated colour, rainbow gradients, neon, lens flare, HDR halos, teal-and-orange grading, blown highlights, obvious stock-photo posing, plastic retouched skin, identifiable people, malformed hands, 3D-render or CGI look, vector or illustration look, dutch tilt, heavy motion blur, collage, borders, frames, device mockup edges, and any object not named above.

Preserve: the colour world, the reserved empty right third, the framing and lens, the single dominant light source, and the complete absence of text.
